title: Meter Formulary and Replacement Intervals, Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program
content:
Meters on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program are listed per tier.

| Tier | Preferred meter models | Non-preferred meter needs a payer formulary exception | Least time between covered meters, calendar months from the previous meter's ship date | Manufacturer warranty, calendar months from delivery |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | Accu-Chek Guide Me, Contour Next One, OneTouch Verio Reflect, FreeStyle Lite, True Metrix Air | No | 0 | 36 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | Accu-Chek Guide Me, Contour Next One | Yes | 36 | 36 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | OneTouch Verio Reflect, Contour Next One, Accu-Chek Guide Me | Yes | 36 | 36 |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | Accu-Chek Guide Me, True Metrix Air | Yes | 60 | 36 |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | Accu-Chek Guide Me, Contour Next One, OneTouch Verio Reflect, FreeStyle Lite, True Metrix Air | No | 60 | 36 |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | Contour Next One, True Metrix Air | Yes | 36 | 36 |

- The preferred list is the tier's list of meter models; strips are covered only for the meter on the program.
- "Needs a payer formulary exception: Yes" means a meter not on the list needs a payer formulary exception, recorded as an approved prior authorization for item E0607, before it and its strips are covered.
- A replacement interval of 0 means there is no payer interval, which is the case on the self-pay tier.
- The warranty is the manufacturer's warranty on a meter, counted in calendar months from its delivery date; it is 36 months on every tier.
